messages.subject: merge issue
parts:
OK R super friends, I have an issue with merge that I've never encountered before.

I have two data frames that share the column "Gene".

I use:
D1 <- merge(Dsuz, fpkm, by ="Gene") 

The data frames merge, but none of the data are in the resulting data.frame except the column "Gene"

A beer to whomever helps me fix this.

Beers

Chris

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Re: merge issue
parts: It looks like there might not be any matching "Gene" values between the two. Check by using sum(Dsuz$Gene%in% fkpm$Gene) to count how many matches there are. If you add all=TRUE to the merge command you can get an "outer" join, which will include ALL, not just matching, records. If there are supposed to be matching "Gene" values, maybe there's a formatting difference between the two files, like trailing spaces after the values in the "Gene" column.
